// FILE: lib/features/session/presentation/cubit/session_details_cubit.dart
import 'dart:async';
import 'package:bloc/bloc.dart';
import 'package:freezed_annotation/freezed_annotation.dart';
import 'package:injectable/injectable.dart';
import 'package:sahbifit/core/errors/failure.dart';
import 'package:sahbifit/features/session/domain/entities/session.dart';
import 'package:sahbifit/features/session/domain/entities/session_participant.dart';
import 'package:sahbifit/features/session/domain/usecases/get_participants_stream.dart';
import 'package:sahbifit/features/session/domain/usecases/get_session_by_id.dart';
import 'package:sahbifit/features/session/domain/usecases/join_session.dart';
import 'package:sahbifit/features/session/domain/usecases/leave_session.dart'; // <--- ADDED IMPORT

part 'session_details_cubit.freezed.dart';
part 'session_details_state.dart';

@injectable
class SessionDetailsCubit extends Cubit<SessionDetailsState> {
  final GetSessionById _getSessionById;
  final JoinSession _joinSession;
  final GetSessionParticipants _getSessionParticipants;
  final LeaveSession _leaveSession; // <--- ADDED

  String? _currentUserId;

  SessionDetailsCubit(
    this._getSessionById,
    this._joinSession,
    this._getSessionParticipants,
    this._leaveSession, // <--- ADDED
  ) : super(const SessionDetailsState.initial());

  Future<void> fetchSessionDetails(String sessionId, String currentUserId) async {
    _currentUserId = currentUserId;
    emit(const SessionDetailsState.loading());

    try {
      final session = await _getSessionById(GetSessionByIdParams(sessionId: sessionId));

      final participants = await _getSessionParticipants(
        GetSessionParticipantsParams(sessionId: sessionId),
      );

      // Logic check: Am I in the list AND active (not left/no_show)?
      // Backend 'leaveSession' might soft-delete (set status to left) or hard-delete.
      // We check if user is in the list. 
      final isJoined = participants.any((p) => p.userId == currentUserId);

      emit(SessionDetailsState.loaded(
        session: session,
        participants: participants,
        isJoined: isJoined,
      ));
    } on ServerFailure catch (e) {
      emit(SessionDetailsState.error(e.message));
    } catch (e) {
      emit(SessionDetailsState.error(e.toString()));
    }
  }

  Future<void> joinSession(String sessionId) async {
    state.maybeMap(
      loaded: (s) async {
        emit(s.copyWith(isJoinLoading: true));
        try {
          await _joinSession(JoinSessionParams(sessionId: sessionId));

          final updatedParticipants = await _getSessionParticipants(
              GetSessionParticipantsParams(sessionId: sessionId)
          );

          emit(s.copyWith(
            isJoinLoading: false,
            isJoined: true,
            participants: updatedParticipants,
          ));
        } on ServerFailure catch (e) {
          emit(s.copyWith(
            isJoinLoading: false,
            errorMessage: e.message,
          ));
          await Future.delayed(const Duration(seconds: 3));
          state.mapOrNull(loaded: (currentState) {
            emit(currentState.copyWith(errorMessage: null));
          });
        }
      },
      orElse: () {},
    );
  }

  // --- ADDED METHOD ---
  Future<void> leaveSession(String sessionId) async {
    state.maybeMap(
      loaded: (s) async {
        emit(s.copyWith(isLeaveLoading: true)); // Set loading flag
        try {
          await _leaveSession(LeaveSessionParams(sessionId: sessionId));

          // Refresh list to reflect removal
          final updatedParticipants = await _getSessionParticipants(
              GetSessionParticipantsParams(sessionId: sessionId)
          );

          // Check if we are still effectively joined (depends on backend hard vs soft delete)
          // If backend hard deletes: user won't be in list.
          // If backend soft deletes (status=left): user is in list, logic in UI handles "left".
          // For 'isJoined' boolean, we usually mean "Is active participant".
          // Let's re-evaluate isJoined based on the new list.
          // NOTE: Backend logic said: hard delete if > 1hr, soft delete (status=no_show/left) if < 1hr.
          
          // If the user is GONE from the list, isJoined = false.
          // If the user is PRESENT but status != joined/attended, isJoined = false.
          final isStillInList = updatedParticipants.any((p) => p.userId == _currentUserId);
          
          emit(s.copyWith(
            isLeaveLoading: false,
            isJoined: isStillInList, // Simple check, UI handles status display
            participants: updatedParticipants,
          ));
        } on ServerFailure catch (e) {
          emit(s.copyWith(
            isLeaveLoading: false,
            errorMessage: e.message,
          ));
          await Future.delayed(const Duration(seconds: 3));
          state.mapOrNull(loaded: (currentState) {
            emit(currentState.copyWith(errorMessage: null));
          });
        }
      },
      orElse: () {},
    );
  }
  // -------------------
}

import 'package:bloc/bloc.dart';
import 'package:freezed_annotation/freezed_annotation.dart';
import 'package:injectable/injectable.dart';
import 'package:sahbifit/core/errors/failure.dart';
import 'package:sahbifit/features/session/domain/entities/session.dart';
import 'package:sahbifit/features/session/domain/usecases/get_active_sessions.dart';
import 'package:sahbifit/features/verification/domain/enums/verified_gender_enum.dart';

part 'session_feed_cubit.freezed.dart';
part 'session_feed_state.dart';

@injectable
class SessionFeedCubit extends Cubit<SessionFeedState> {
  final GetActiveSessions _getActiveSessions;

  SessionFeedCubit(this._getActiveSessions)
      : super(const SessionFeedState.initial());

  /// Fetches the list of active sessions, optionally applying a gender filter.
  Future<void> fetchSessions({VerifiedGender? genderFilter}) async {
    emit(const SessionFeedState.loading());
    try {
      final params = GetActiveSessionsParams(genderFilter: genderFilter);
      final sessions = await _getActiveSessions(params);

      emit(SessionFeedState.loaded(
        sessions: sessions,
        genderFilter: genderFilter,
      ));
    } on ServerFailure catch (e) {
      emit(SessionFeedState.error(e.message));
    } catch (e) {
      emit(SessionFeedState.error(e.toString()));
    }
  }
}

class CreateSessionPage extends StatelessWidget {
  const CreateSessionPage({super.key});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return MultiBlocProvider(
      providers: [
        BlocProvider(create: (context) => getIt<CreateSessionCubit>()),
        BlocProvider(create: (context) => getIt<GymListCubit>()..fetchApprovedGyms()),
      ],
      child: BlocListener<CreateSessionCubit, CreateSessionState>(
        listener: (context, state) {
          if (state.status == CreateSessionStatus.success) {
            ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
              const SnackBar(
                content: Text('Session created successfully!'),
                backgroundColor: AppTheme.successGreen,
              ),
            );
            context.pushReplacement('/session/${state.createdSession!.sessionId}');
          } else if (state.status == CreateSessionStatus.error) {
            ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
              SnackBar(
                content: Text(state.errorMessage ?? 'An error occurred.'),
                backgroundColor: AppTheme.primaryRed,
              ),
            );
          }
        },
        child: Scaffold(
          appBar: const CustomAppBar(title: 'Plan a Workout'),
          body: SingleChildScrollView(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(AppTheme.defaultPadding),
            child: _CreateSessionForm(),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _CreateSessionForm extends StatefulWidget {
  @override
  State<_CreateSessionForm> createState() => _CreateSessionFormState();
}

class _CreateSessionFormState extends State<_CreateSessionForm> {
  // Local state for UI friendliness before sending to Cubit
  DateTime _selectedDay = DateTime.now();
  TimeOfDay _startTime = TimeOfDay.now();
  TimeOfDay _endTime = TimeOfDay.now().replacing(hour: TimeOfDay.now().hour + 1);

  Future<void> _pickDay(BuildContext context) async {
    final DateTime? picked = await showDatePicker(
      context: context,
      initialDate: _selectedDay,
      firstDate: DateTime.now(),
      lastDate: DateTime.now().add(const Duration(days: 30)),
    );
    if (picked != null) {
      setState(() => _selectedDay = picked);
      _updateCubit();
    }
  }

  Future<void> _pickTime(BuildContext context, bool isStart) async {
    final TimeOfDay? picked = await showTimePicker(
      context: context,
      initialTime: isStart ? _startTime : _endTime,
    );
    if (picked != null) {
      setState(() {
        if (isStart) {
          _startTime = picked;
          // Auto-adjust end time to be 1 hour later if it becomes invalid
          if (_endTime.hour < _startTime.hour || 
             (_endTime.hour == _startTime.hour && _endTime.minute <= _startTime.minute)) {
             _endTime = picked.replacing(hour: picked.hour + 1);
          }
        } else {
          _endTime = picked;
        }
      });
      _updateCubit();
    }
  }

  void _updateCubit() {
    final start = DateTime(
      _selectedDay.year, _selectedDay.month, _selectedDay.day, 
      _startTime.hour, _startTime.minute
    );
    final end = DateTime(
      _selectedDay.year, _selectedDay.month, _selectedDay.day, 
      _endTime.hour, _endTime.minute
    );
    
    context.read<CreateSessionCubit>().startTimeChanged(start);
    context.read<CreateSessionCubit>().endTimeChanged(end);
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final cubit = context.watch<CreateSessionCubit>();
    final state = cubit.state;

    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      children: [
        // 1. What & Where
        Text('Session Details', style: context.textTheme.headlineSmall),
        const SizedBox(height: AppTheme.elementSpacing),
        PrimaryTextField(
          label: 'Title',
          hintText: 'e.g., Chest Day, HIIT Cardio',
          onChanged: cubit.titleChanged,
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: AppTheme.defaultPadding),
        
        // Gym Selector with "Not Found" link
        _GymSelector(), 
        Align(
          alignment: Alignment.centerRight,
          child: TextButton(
            onPressed: () => context.push('/submit-gym'),
            child: const Text('Gym not listed? Add it now', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12)),
          ),
        ),

        const SizedBox(height: AppTheme.sectionSpacing),

        // 2. When
        Text('Schedule', style: context.textTheme.headlineSmall),
        const SizedBox(height: AppTheme.elementSpacing),
        
        // Day Picker
        _buildSelectionTile(
          context,
          icon: Icons.calendar_month,
          label: "Date",
          value: DateFormat('EEEE, MMMM d, y').format(_selectedDay),
          onTap: () => _pickDay(context),
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 8),
        Row(
          children: [
            Expanded(
              child: _buildSelectionTile(
                context,
                icon: Icons.access_time,

            Expanded(
              child: _buildSelectionTile(
                context,
                icon: Icons.access_time_filled,
                label: "End",
                value: _endTime.format(context),
                onTap: () => _pickTime(context, false),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),

        const SizedBox(height: AppTheme.sectionSpacing),

        // 3. Who
        Text('Type & Participants', style: context.textTheme.headlineSmall),
        const SizedBox(height: AppTheme.elementSpacing),
        
        SessionTypeToggle(
          selectedType: state.sessionType,
          onTypeChanged: cubit.sessionTypeChanged,
        ),
        
        const SizedBox(height: AppTheme.defaultPadding),

        if (state.sessionType == SessionType.group) ...[
          Row(
            mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
            children: [
              Text('Group Size', style: context.textTheme.titleMedium),
              Text('${state.maxParticipants} people', 
                style: context.textTheme.titleMedium?.copyWith(color: AppTheme.primaryRed)),
            ],
          ),
          Slider(
            value: state.maxParticipants.toDouble(),
            min: 3, // Requirement: Group session cannot be 2, must be 3+
            max: 10,
            divisions: 7,
            activeColor: AppTheme.primaryRed,
            onChanged: (value) => cubit.maxParticipantsChanged(value.toInt()),
          ),
          Text(
            'Group sessions are for 3 or more people.',
            style: context.textTheme.bodySmall?.copyWith(color: AppTheme.disabledGray),
          ),
        ] else ...[
           Container(
             padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
             decoration: BoxDecoration(
               color: AppTheme.lightGray,
               borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
             ),
             child: Row(
               children: [
                 const Icon(Icons.info_outline, size: 16, color: AppTheme.darkGray),
                 const SizedBox(width: 8),
                 const Text("1-on-1 sessions are strictly for 2 people."),
               ],
             ),
           ),
        ],

        const SizedBox(height: AppTheme.sectionSpacing * 2),

        PrimaryButton(
          text: 'Create Session',
          isLoading: state.status == CreateSessionStatus.loading,
          onPressed: () {
            // Ensure cubit has latest times
            _updateCubit();
            cubit.submitCreateSession();
          },
        ),
      ],
    );
  }

  Widget _buildSelectionTile(BuildContext context, {required IconData icon, required String label, required String value, required VoidCallback onTap}) {
    return InkWell(
      onTap: onTap,
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
      child: Container(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          border: Border.all(color: AppTheme.disabledGray.withAlpha(100)),
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
        ),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            Text(label, style: context.textTheme.bodySmall?.copyWith(color: AppTheme.disabledGray)),
            const SizedBox(height: 4),
            Row(
              children: [
                Icon(icon, size: 18, color: AppTheme.primaryRed),
                const SizedBox(width: 8),
                Text(value, style: context.textTheme.titleMedium),
              ],
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _GymSelector extends StatelessWidget {
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final createCubit = context.read<CreateSessionCubit>();
    return BlocBuilder<GymListCubit, GymListState>(
      builder: (context, state) {
        return state.map(
          initial: (_) => const LoadingIndicator(message: "Loading Gyms..."),
          loading: (_) => const LoadingIndicator(message: "Loading Gyms..."),
          error: (e) => Text('Error loading gyms: ${e.message}'),
          loaded: (s) {
            return DropdownButtonFormField<Gym>(
              decoration: const InputDecoration(
                labelText: 'Select Gym',
                prefixIcon: Icon(Icons.location_on_outlined),
              ),
              items: s.gyms
                  .map((gym) => DropdownMenuItem(
                        value: gym,
                        child: Text(gym.name),
                      ))
                  .toList(),
              onChanged: (gym) {
                if (gym != null) createCubit.gymChanged(gym);
              },
            );
          },
        );
      },
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

class MarkAttendancePage extends StatelessWidget {
  final String sessionId;

  const MarkAttendancePage({super.key, required this.sessionId});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return BlocProvider(
      create: (context) => getIt<MarkAttendanceCubit>()..loadSession(sessionId),
      child: Scaffold(
        appBar: const CustomAppBar(title: 'Mark Attendance'),
        body: const _AttendanceBody(),
      ),
    );
  }

class _AttendanceBody extends StatelessWidget {
  const _AttendanceBody();

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return BlocConsumer<MarkAttendanceCubit, MarkAttendanceState>(
      listener: (context, state) {
        state.maybeMap(
          loaded: (s) {
            if (s.errorMessage != null) {
              ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
                SnackBar(content: Text(s.errorMessage!), backgroundColor: AppTheme.primaryRed),
              );
            }
          },
          orElse: () {},
        );
      },
      builder: (context, state) {
        return state.map(
          initial: (_) => const LoadingIndicator(),
          loading: (_) => const LoadingIndicator(),
          error: (e) => ErrorStateWidget(
            message: e.message,
            buttonText: 'Retry',
            onRetry: () => context.read<MarkAttendanceCubit>().loadSession(context.read<MarkAttendanceCubit>().state.maybeMap(loaded: (s) => s.session.sessionId, orElse: () => '')),
          ),
          loaded: (s) {
            if (s.participants.isEmpty) {
              return const Center(child: Text("No participants joined yet."));
            }

            return Column(
              children: [
                if (s.isSubmitting) const LinearProgressIndicator(),
                Expanded(
                  child: ListView.separated(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
                    itemCount: s.participants.length,
                    separatorBuilder: (_, __) => const SizedBox(height: 12),
                    itemBuilder: (context, index) {
                      final p = s.participants[index];
                      // Don't show the host in the attendance list
                      if (p.userId == s.session.creator.userId) return const SizedBox.shrink();

                      return Card(
                        elevation: 2,
                        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12)),
                        child: Padding(
                          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12.0),
                          child: Row(
                            children: [
                              CircleAvatar(
                                backgroundImage: p.user.profilePhotoUrl != null 
                                  ? NetworkImage(p.user.profilePhotoUrl!) 
                                  : null,
                                child: p.user.profilePhotoUrl == null 
                                  ? Text(p.user.firstName[0]) 
                                  : null,
                              ),
                              const SizedBox(width: 12),
                              Expanded(
                                child: Column(
                                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                                  children: [
                                    Text(p.user.firstName, style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, fontSize: 16)),
                                    Text(
                                      p.status == ParticipantStatus.joined ? "Not marked yet" : p.status.name.toUpperCase(),
                                      style: TextStyle(
                                        color: p.status == ParticipantStatus.attended ? AppTheme.successGreen : Colors.grey,
                                        fontSize: 12,
                                      ),
                                    ),
                                  ],
                                ),
                              ),
                              // Action Buttons
                              Row(
                                children: [
                                  _AttendanceButton(
                                    icon: Icons.check,
                                    color: AppTheme.successGreen,
                                    isSelected: p.status == ParticipantStatus.attended,
                                    onTap: () => context.read<MarkAttendanceCubit>().submitAttendance(p.userId, ParticipantStatus.attended),
                                  ),
                                  const SizedBox(width: 8),
                                  _AttendanceButton(
                                    icon: Icons.close,
                                    color: AppTheme.primaryRed,
                                    isSelected: p.status == ParticipantStatus.noShow,
                                    onTap: () => context.read<MarkAttendanceCubit>().submitAttendance(p.userId, ParticipantStatus.noShow),
                                  ),
                                ],
                              )
                            ],
                          ),
                        ),
                      );
                    },
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            );
          },
        );
      },
    );
  }
}

class _AttendanceButton extends StatelessWidget {
  final IconData icon;
  final Color color;
  final bool isSelected;
  final VoidCallback onTap;

  const _AttendanceButton({
    required this.icon,
    required this.color,
    required this.isSelected,
    required this.onTap,
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return InkWell(
      onTap: onTap,
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
      child: Container(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(8),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: isSelected ? color : Colors.transparent,
          border: Border.all(color: isSelected ? color : Colors.grey.shade300),
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
        ),
        child: Icon(
          icon,
          color: isSelected ? Colors.white : Colors.grey,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import 'package:sahbifit/features/session/presentation/widgets/session_card.dart';

class MySessionsPage extends StatelessWidget {
  const MySessionsPage({super.key});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return BlocProvider(
      create: (context) => getIt<MySessionsCubit>()..loadMySessions(),
      child: DefaultTabController(
        length: 2,
        child: Scaffold(
          appBar: AppBar(
            title: const Text('My Sessions'),
            bottom: TabBar(
              indicatorColor: AppTheme.primaryRed,
              labelColor: AppTheme.primaryRed,
              unselectedLabelColor: AppTheme.disabledGray,
              labelStyle: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleMedium,
              tabs: const [
                Tab(text: 'Upcoming'),
                Tab(text: 'History'),
              ],
            ),
          ),
          body: const TabBarView(
            children: [
              _SessionList(isHistory: false),
              _SessionList(isHistory: true),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _SessionList extends StatelessWidget {
  final bool isHistory;

  const _SessionList({required this.isHistory});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return BlocBuilder<MySessionsCubit, MySessionsState>(
      builder: (context, state) {
        if (state is MySessionsLoading) {
          return const LoadingIndicator(message: "Loading sessions...");
        } else if (state is MySessionsError) {
          return ErrorStateWidget(
            message: state.message,
            buttonText: "Retry",
            onRetry: () => context.read<MySessionsCubit>().loadMySessions(),
          );
        } else if (state is MySessionsLoaded) {
          
          final sessions = isHistory ? state.pastSessions : state.upcomingSessions;

          if (sessions.isEmpty) {
            return EmptyStateWidget(
              title: isHistory ? 'No History' : 'No Plans Yet',
              message: isHistory 
                  ? 'You haven\'t attended any sessions yet.' 
                  : 'Join a session or create one to see it here.',
              icon: isHistory ? Icons.history_toggle_off : Icons.calendar_today_outlined,
              buttonText: isHistory ? null : "Find Sessions",
              onButtonPressed: isHistory ? null : () => context.go('/home'),
            );
          }

          return RefreshIndicator(
            onRefresh: () => context.read<MySessionsCubit>().loadMySessions(),
            child: ListView.builder(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
              itemCount: sessions.length,
              itemBuilder: (context, index) {
                final session = sessions[index];
                return SessionCardWrapper(
                  session: session,
                  isLocked: false, // My sessions are always unlocked
                  isPast: isHistory,
                );
              },
            ),
          );
        }
        return const SizedBox.shrink();
      },
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';

class SessionDetailsPage extends StatefulWidget {
  final String sessionId;
  const SessionDetailsPage({
    super.key,
    required this.sessionId,
  });

  @override
  State<SessionDetailsPage> createState() => _SessionDetailsPageState();
}

class _SessionDetailsPageState extends State<SessionDetailsPage> {

  // --- ADDED: Confirmation Logic ---
  void _onLeavePressed(BuildContext context, Session session) {
    final now = DateTime.now();
    // 1 hour cutoff
    final penaltyCutoff = session.startTime.subtract(const Duration(hours: 1));
    final isLateCancellation = now.isAfter(penaltyCutoff);

    if (isLateCancellation) {
      // Show WARNING Dialog
      showDialog(
        context: context,
        builder: (_) => ConfirmationDialog(
          title: 'Late Cancellation Warning',
          message: 'The session starts in less than 1 hour.\n\n'
              'Cancelling now will count as a "Late Cancel". '
              'Frequent late cancellations (6+) result in an "Unreliable" badge and temporary suspension.\n\n'
              'Are you sure?',
          confirmText: 'Yes, Cancel Anyway',
          cancelText: 'Go Back',
          onConfirm: () {
             context.read<SessionDetailsCubit>().leaveSession(session.sessionId);
          },
        ),
      );
    } else {
      // Show SAFE Dialog
      showDialog(
        context: context,
        builder: (_) => ConfirmationDialog(
          title: 'Leave Session?',
          message: 'Are you sure you want to leave this session? '
              'This spot will open up for others.',
          confirmText: 'Leave',
          cancelText: 'Stay',
          onConfirm: () {
             context.read<SessionDetailsCubit>().leaveSession(session.sessionId);
          },
        ),
      );
    }
  }
  // ---------------------------------

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return BlocBuilder<ProfileBloc, ProfileState>(
      builder: (context, profileState) {
        return profileState.when(
          initial: () => const Scaffold(body: LoadingIndicator(message: 'Loading profile...')),
          loading: () => const Scaffold(body: LoadingIndicator(message: 'Loading profile...')),
          error: (message) => Scaffold(
            body: ErrorStateWidget(
              message: message,
              buttonText: 'Retry',
              onRetry: () => context
                  .read<ProfileBloc>()
                  .add(const ProfileEvent.loadMyProfile()),
            ),
          ),

          loaded: (currentUser) {
            return BlocProvider(
              create: (context) => getIt<SessionDetailsCubit>()
                ..fetchSessionDetails(widget.sessionId, currentUser.userId),
              child: Scaffold(
                body: Builder(
                    builder: (context) {
                      return BlocConsumer<SessionDetailsCubit, SessionDetailsState>(
                        listener: (context, state) {
                          state.maybeMap(
                            loaded: (s) {
                              if (s.errorMessage != null) {
                                ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
                                  SnackBar(
                                    content: Text(s.errorMessage!),
                                    backgroundColor: AppTheme.primaryRed,
                                  ),
                                );
                              }
                            },
                            orElse: () {},
                          );
                        },
                        builder: (context, state) {
                          return state.when(
                            initial: () => const LoadingIndicator(),
                            loading: () => const LoadingIndicator(),
                            error: (message) => Center(
                              child: ErrorStateWidget(
                                message: message,
                                buttonText: 'Try Again',
                                onRetry: () => context.read<SessionDetailsCubit>()
                                    .fetchSessionDetails(widget.sessionId, currentUser.userId),
                              ),
                            ),
                            loaded: (session, participants, isJoined, isJoinLoading, isLeaveLoading, errorMessage) {
                              return _buildLoadedBody(
                                context,
                                session,
                                participants,
                                isJoined,
                                isJoinLoading,
                                isLeaveLoading, // Pass new state
                                errorMessage,
                                currentUser,
                              );
                            },
                          );
                        },
                      );
                    }
                ),
              ),
            );
          },
        );
      },
    );
  }

  Widget _buildLoadedBody(
      BuildContext context,
      Session session,
      List<SessionParticipant> participants,
      bool isJoined,
      bool isJoinLoading,
      bool isLeaveLoading, // <--- Arg
      String? errorMessage,
      User currentUser,
      ) {
    final isCreator = session.creator.userId == currentUser.userId;
    
    // Find my participant record if joined
    SessionParticipant? myParticipant;
    if (isJoined) {
      try {
        myParticipant = participants.firstWhere((p) => p.userId == currentUser.userId);
      } catch (_) {}
    }

    // If status is 'left' or 'no_show', treat as NOT effectively joined for the button logic
    // (User sees 'Join' again or 'Left' status)
    final bool isEffectivelyJoined = isJoined && 
        (myParticipant?.status == ParticipantStatus.joined || myParticipant?.status == ParticipantStatus.attended);

    return CustomScrollView(
      slivers: [
        SliverAppBar(
          title: Text(
            session.title,
            style: Theme.of(context).appBarTheme.titleTextStyle,
          ),
          backgroundColor: AppTheme.cleanWhite,
          foregroundColor: AppTheme.darkGray,
          elevation: 0,
          pinned: true,
          floating: true,
          leading: IconButton(
            icon: const Icon(Icons.arrow_back_ios_rounded),
            onPressed: () => context.pop(),
          ),
        ),

        SliverToBoxAdapter(
          child: Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(AppTheme.defaultPadding),
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: [
                _buildInfoTile(
                  context,
                  icon: Icons.calendar_today_rounded,
                  title: 'Date & Time',
                  subtitle:
                  '${formatReadableDateTime(session.startTime.toIso8601String())}\n${formatReadableTime(session.endTime.toIso8601String())} (End)',
                ),
                _buildInfoTile(
                  context,
                  icon: Icons.location_on_rounded,
                  title: 'Location',
                  subtitle: session.gym.name,
                ),
                _buildInfoTile(
                  context,
                  icon: Icons.people_rounded,
                  title: 'Participants',
                  subtitle:
                  '${participants.length} / ${session.maxParticipants} joined',
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: AppTheme.elementSpacing),
                ListTile(
                  contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                  leading: const CircleAvatar(
                    // Placeholder
                  ),
                  title: Text('Hosted by ${session.creator.firstName}',
                      style: context.textTheme.titleMedium),
                  subtitle: const Text('View Profile'),
                  onTap: () =>
                      context.push('/user/${session.creator.userId}'),
                ),
                const Divider(),
                const SizedBox(height: AppTheme.elementSpacing),
                Text('Who\'s Going', style: context.textTheme.headlineSmall),
                const SizedBox(height: AppTheme.elementSpacing),
                SessionParticipantList(participants: participants),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
        SliverFillRemaining(
          hasScrollBody: false,
          child: _buildBottomButton(
            context,
            session,
            participants,
            isEffectivelyJoined, // Use the corrected bool
            isJoinLoading,
            isLeaveLoading,
            isCreator,
            currentUser,
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }

  Widget _buildInfoTile(
      BuildContext context, {
        required IconData icon,
        required String title,
        required String subtitle,
      }) {
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 8.0),
      child: Row(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          Icon(icon, color: AppTheme.primaryRed, size: 20),
          const SizedBox(width: 16),
          Expanded(
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: [
                Text(title, style: context.textTheme.titleMedium),
                const SizedBox(height: 2),
                Text(subtitle, style: context.textTheme.bodyMedium),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildBottomButton(
      BuildContext context,
      Session session,
      List<SessionParticipant> participants,
      bool isJoined, // This is now isEffectivelyJoined
      bool isJoinLoading,
      bool isLeaveLoading,
      bool isCreator,
      User currentUser,
      ) {
    final bool isFull = participants.length >= session.maxParticipants;
    final bool hasAttendedGroupSession = currentUser.groupSessionCount > 0;
    final bool isOneOnOne = session.sessionType == SessionType.oneOnOne;
    final bool isGated = isOneOnOne && !hasAttendedGroupSession;

    final bool canChat = DateTime.now()
        .isAfter(session.startTime.subtract(const Duration(hours: 1))) &&
        DateTime.now().isBefore(session.endTime.add(const Duration(hours: 1)));

    final bool canMarkAttendance = DateTime.now().isAfter(session.startTime);

    final cubit = context.read<SessionDetailsCubit>();

    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(AppTheme.defaultPadding),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: AppTheme.cleanWhite,
        boxShadow: [
          BoxShadow(
            color: Colors.black.withAlpha(13),
            blurRadius: 10,
            offset: const Offset(0, -5),
          ),
        ],
      ),
      child: Column(
        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
        children: [
          if (isCreator)
            if (canMarkAttendance)
              PrimaryButton(
                text: 'Mark Attendance',
                onPressed: () =>
                    context.push('/session/${session.sessionId}/attendance'),
              )
            else
              Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(8.0),
                child: Text(
                  "Attendance opens after session starts",
                  style: context.textTheme.bodyMedium?.copyWith(
                    color: AppTheme.darkGray,
                    fontStyle: FontStyle.italic,
                  ),
                ),
              )
          else if (isJoined)
            // --- UPDATED: Show Chat Button + Leave Button ---
            Row(
              children: [
                Expanded(
                  flex: 2,
                  child: PrimaryButton(
                    text: canChat ? 'Open Chat' : 'Chat (Locked)',
                    // Chat is only primary action
                    onPressed: canChat
                        ? () => context.push('/session/${session.sessionId}/chat')
                        : null,
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: 12),
                Expanded(
                  flex: 1,
                  child: SecondaryButton(
                    text: 'Leave',
                    isLoading: isLeaveLoading,
                    onPressed: () => _onLeavePressed(context, session),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            )
          else if (isFull)
              const PrimaryButton(
                text: 'Session Full',
                onPressed: null,
              )
            else
              PrimaryButton(
                text: isGated
                    ? 'Join (Requires 1 Group Session)'
                    : 'Join Session',
                isLoading: isJoinLoading,
                onPressed: isGated
                    ? () => showReputationGateDialog(context)
                    : () => cubit.joinSession(session.sessionId),
              ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

class SessionFeedPage extends StatefulWidget { // <-- CONVERTED TO STATEFUL

  @override
  State<SessionFeedPage> createState() => _SessionFeedPageState();

class _SessionFeedPageState extends State<SessionFeedPage> { // <-- CREATED STATE
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    // --- ADDED: Trigger profile load on init ---
    // Assumes ProfileBloc is provided above this widget (e.g., in your router)
    context.read<ProfileBloc>().add(const ProfileEvent.loadMyProfile());
    // -------------------------------------------
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    // --- MODIFIED: Watch ProfileBloc instead of AppBloc ---
    final profileState = context.watch<ProfileBloc>().state;
    // ----------------------------------------------------

    // --- MODIFIED: Handle ProfileBloc states ---
    return profileState.maybeWhen(
      loading: () =>
          const Scaffold(body: LoadingIndicator(message: 'Loading profile...')),
      error: (message) => Scaffold(
        body: ErrorStateWidget(
          message: message,
          buttonText: 'Try Again',
          onRetry: () =>
              context.read<ProfileBloc>().add(const ProfileEvent.loadMyProfile()),
        ),
      ),
      loaded: (currentUser) {
        // We have the user, now build the session feed
        return BlocProvider(
          create: (context) => getIt<SessionFeedCubit>()..fetchSessions(),
          child: Scaffold(
            appBar: const CustomAppBar(
              title: 'Sessions',
              showBackButton: false,
              // You could add filter actions here
            ),
            body: BlocBuilder<SessionFeedCubit, SessionFeedState>(
              builder: (context, state) {
                return state.map(
                  initial: (_) => const LoadingIndicator(),
                  loading: (_) => const LoadingIndicator(),
                  error: (e) => ErrorStateWidget(
                    message: e.message,
                    buttonText: 'Try Again',
                    onRetry: () =>
                        context.read<SessionFeedCubit>().fetchSessions(),
                  ),
                  loaded: (s) {
                    if (s.sessions.isEmpty) {
                      return Center(
                        child: EmptyStateWidget(
                          icon: Icons.search_off_rounded,
                          title: 'No Sessions Yet',
                          message:
                              'Looks quiet... Why not be the first to host one?',
                          buttonText: 'Create a Session',
                          onButtonPressed: () =>
                              context.push('/create-session'),
                        ),
                      );
                    }
                    return RefreshIndicator(
                      onRefresh: () =>
                          context.read<SessionFeedCubit>().fetchSessions(),
                      child: ListView.builder(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 8, bottom: 80),
                        itemCount: s.sessions.length,
                        itemBuilder: (context, index) {
                          final session = s.sessions[index];

                          // Feature 2: Probationary Mode Logic
                          final bool isAmbassadorSession =
                              session.creator.role == UserRole.admin;
                          final bool isLocked =
                              currentUser.verificationStatus ==
                                      VerificationStatus.pendingReview &&
                                  !isAmbassadorSession;

                          return SessionCardWrapper(
                            session: session,
                            isLocked: isLocked,
                          );
                        },
                      ),
                    );
                  },
                );
              },
            ),
            floatingActionButton: FloatingActionButton(
              onPressed: () => context.push('/create-session'),
              child: const Icon(Icons.add),
            ),
          ),
        );
      },
      orElse: () =>
          const Scaffold(body: LoadingIndicator(message: 'Initializing...')),
    );
    // ----------------------------------------------------
  }
}

import 'package:go_router/go_router.dart';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:sahbifit/core/utils/date_formatters.dart';
import 'package:sahbifit/features/session/domain/entities/session.dart';
import 'package:sahbifit/features/session/presentation/widgets/probation_locked_tooltip.dart';
import 'package:sahbifit/features/user/domain/enums/user_role.dart';
import 'package:sahbifit/shared/widgets/cards/custom_cards.dart';

class SessionCardWrapper extends StatelessWidget {
  final Session session;
  final bool isLocked;
  final bool isPast; // <--- 1. Add this

  const SessionCardWrapper({
    super.key,
    required this.session,
    required this.isLocked,
    this.isPast = false, // <--- 2. Default to false
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    // Check if the creator is an Ambassador
    final bool isAmbassadorSession =
        session.creator.role == UserRole.admin; 

    // 3. Create the base card
    Widget card = SessionCard(
      title: session.title,
      subtitle: 'Hosted by ${session.creator.firstName}',
      time: formatReadableTime(session.startTime.toIso8601String()),
      location: session.gym.name,
      participants: session.participantCount,
      maxParticipants: session.maxParticipants,
      isLocked: isLocked,
      isVerified: isAmbassadorSession,
      onTap: () {
        // Allow clicking past sessions to see details, but maybe not join?
        // For now, we keep navigation enabled.
        context.push('/session/${session.sessionId}');
      },
    );

    // 4. Apply "Past" Visuals (Grayscale + Dimmed)
    if (isPast) {
      card = ColorFiltered(
        colorFilter: const ColorFilter.mode(
          Colors.grey, 
          BlendMode.saturation, // Removes color (grayscale)
        ),
        child: Opacity(
          opacity: 0.7, // Makes it slightly faded
          child: card,
        ),
      );
    }

    // 5. Handle Locking (Only if NOT past, assuming history shouldn't be locked)
    if (isLocked && !isPast) {
      return GestureDetector(
        onTap: () => showProbationLockedDialog(context),
        child: card,
      );
    } else {
      return card;
    }
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:go_router/go_router.dart';
import 'package:sahbifit/core/config/app_theme.dart';
import 'package:sahbifit/features/session/domain/entities/session_participant.dart';
import 'package:sahbifit/features/session/domain/enums/participant_status.dart';

class SessionParticipantList extends StatelessWidget {
  final List<SessionParticipant> participants;
  final Function(String userId, ParticipantStatus status)? onMarkAttendance;

  const SessionParticipantList({
    super.key,
    required this.participants,
    this.onMarkAttendance,
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    if (participants.isEmpty) {
      return Center(
        child: Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(32.0),
          child: Text(
            'No one has joined yet. Be the first!',
            style: AppTheme.lockedFeatureText,
            textAlign: TextAlign.center,
          ),
        ),
      );
    }

    return ListView.separated(
      shrinkWrap: true,
      physics: const NeverScrollableScrollPhysics(),
      itemCount: participants.length,
      separatorBuilder: (context, index) => const Divider(height: 1),
      itemBuilder: (context, index) {
        final participant = participants[index];

        return ListTile(
          contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero, // Removes default padding to align with page
          onTap: () {
            // Navigate to user profile on tap
            context.push('/user/${participant.userId}');
          },
          leading: CircleAvatar(
            backgroundColor: AppTheme.lightGray,
            // Load image if available, otherwise null (falls back to child)
            backgroundImage: participant.user.profilePhotoUrl != null
                ? NetworkImage(participant.user.profilePhotoUrl!)
                : null,
            child: participant.user.profilePhotoUrl == null
                ? Text(
                    participant.user.firstName.substring(0, 1).toUpperCase(),
                    style: const TextStyle(color: AppTheme.darkGray),
                  )
                : null,
          ),
          title: Text(
            participant.user.firstName,
            style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleMedium,
          ),
          subtitle: Text(
            'Status: ${participant.status.name}',
            style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodySmall?.copyWith(
                  color: _getStatusColor(participant.status),
                ),
          ),
          // If onMarkAttendance is provided (Admin/Owner), show buttons.
          // Otherwise, show a forward arrow to indicate navigation is possible.
          trailing: onMarkAttendance != null
              ? _buildAttendanceButtons(context, participant)
              : const Icon(
                  Icons.arrow_forward_ios,
                  size: 14,
                  color: AppTheme.disabledGray,
                ),
        );
      },
    );
  }

  Widget _buildAttendanceButtons(
      BuildContext context, SessionParticipant participant) {
    return Row(
      mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
      children: [
        IconButton(
          icon: Icon(
            Icons.check_circle_rounded,
            color: participant.status == ParticipantStatus.attended
                ? AppTheme.successGreen
                : AppTheme.disabledGray,
          ),
          onPressed: () =>
              onMarkAttendance!(participant.userId, ParticipantStatus.attended),
        ),
        IconButton(
          icon: Icon(
            Icons.cancel_rounded,
            color: participant.status == ParticipantStatus.noShow
                ? AppTheme.primaryRed
                : AppTheme.disabledGray,
          ),
          onPressed: () =>
              onMarkAttendance!(participant.userId, ParticipantStatus.noShow),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }

  Color _getStatusColor(ParticipantStatus status) {
    switch (status) {
      case ParticipantStatus.attended:
        return AppTheme.successGreen;
      case ParticipantStatus.noShow:
        return AppTheme.primaryRed;
      case ParticipantStatus.joined:
        return AppTheme.trustBlue;
      default:
        return AppTheme.disabledGray;
    }
  }
}

class _ToggleButton extends StatelessWidget {
  final String label;
  final IconData icon;
  final bool isSelected;
  final VoidCallback onTap;

  const _ToggleButton({
    required this.label,
    required this.icon,
    required this.isSelected,
    required this.onTap,
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final color = isSelected ? AppTheme.primaryRed : AppTheme.darkGray;
    final bgColor =
        isSelected ? AppTheme.primaryRed.withAlpha(26) : AppTheme.lightGray;

    return GestureDetector(
      onTap: onTap,
      child: Container(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 16, horizontal: 12),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: bgColor,
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
          border: Border.all(
            color: isSelected ? AppTheme.primaryRed : Colors.transparent,
            width: 1.5,
          ),
        ),
        child: Column(
          children: [
            Icon(icon, color: color, size: 28),
            const SizedBox(height: 8),
            Text(
              label,
              style: context.textTheme.bodyMedium?.copyWith(
                color: color,
                fontWeight: isSelected ? FontWeight.w600 : FontWeight.w500,
              ),
              textAlign: TextAlign.center,
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'package:dio/dio.dart';
import 'package:injectable/injectable.dart';
import 'package:sahbifit/core/api/api_client.dart';
import 'package:sahbifit/core/constants/api_endpoints.dart';
import 'package:sahbifit/core/errors/exceptions.dart';
import 'package:sahbifit/features/tag/data/models/tag_model.dart';
import 'package:sahbifit/features/tag/domain/entities/tag_type.dart';

abstract class TagRemoteDatasource {
  Future<List<TagModel>> getTagsByType(TagType type);
}

@Injectable(as: TagRemoteDatasource)
class TagRemoteDatasourceImpl implements TagRemoteDatasource {
  final ApiClient _apiClient;

  TagRemoteDatasourceImpl(this._apiClient);

  @override
  Future<List<TagModel>> getTagsByType(TagType type) async {
    try {
      final response = await _apiClient.dio.get(
        ApiEndpoints.tags,
        queryParameters: {
          'type': type.name, // Sends ?type=goal or ?type=schedule
        },
      );

      // Convert the List<dynamic> from JSON to List<TagModel>
      return (response.data as List)
          .map((json) => TagModel.fromJson(json))
          .toList();
    } on DioException catch (e) {
      throw ServerException.fromDio(e);
    }
  }
}

import 'package:bloc/bloc.dart';
import 'package:freezed_annotation/freezed_annotation.dart';
import 'package:injectable/injectable.dart';
import 'package:sahbifit/core/errors/failure.dart';
import 'package:sahbifit/features/tag/domain/entities/tag.dart';
import 'package:sahbifit/features/tag/domain/entities/tag_type.dart';
import 'package:sahbifit/features/tag/domain/usecases/get_tags_by_type.dart';

part 'tags_cubit.freezed.dart';
part 'tags_state.dart';

@injectable
class TagsCubit extends Cubit<TagsState> {
  final GetTagsByType _getTagsByType;

  TagsCubit(this._getTagsByType) : super(const TagsState.initial());

  /// Fetches both GOAL and SCHEDULE tags concurrently.
  Future<void> loadAllTags() async {
    emit(const TagsState.loading());
    try {
      // Use Future.wait to fetch both lists in parallel
      final results = await Future.wait([
        _getTagsByType(const GetTagsByTypeParams(type: TagType.goal)),
        _getTagsByType(const GetTagsByTypeParams(type: TagType.schedule)),
      ]);

      // Extract the results
      final goalTags = results[0];
      final scheduleTags = results[1];

      emit(TagsState.loaded(
        goalTags: goalTags,
        scheduleTags: scheduleTags,
      ));
    } on ServerFailure catch (e) {
      emit(TagsState.error(e.message));
    } catch (e) {
      emit(TagsState.error(e.toString()));
    }
  }
}

@freezed
sealed class TagsState with _$TagsState {

  const factory TagsState.initial() = _Initial;

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:sahbifit/core/config/app_theme.dart';
import 'package:sahbifit/features/tag/domain/entities/tag.dart';
import 'package:sahbifit/shared/widgets/badges/custom_badges.dart';

/// A reusable widget to display a list of tags as selectable chips.
///
/// This widget is used in the profile setup (for goals/schedule) and
/// when creating a session.
class TagSelectionWidget extends StatelessWidget {
  /// The title displayed above the chips (e.g., "Fitness Goals").
  final String title;

  /// The complete list of tags to display for this section.
  final List<Tag> allTags;

  /// The set of tags that are currently selected.
  final Set<Tag> selectedTags;

  /// Callback function triggered when any tag chip is tapped.
  /// The parent widget is responsible for updating the `selectedTags` set.
  final Function(Tag tag) onTagSelected;

  const TagSelectionWidget({
    super.key,
    required this.title,
    required this.allTags,
    required this.selectedTags,
    required this.onTagSelected,
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      children: [
        // Title for the section
        Text(
          title,
          style: context.textTheme.titleMedium,
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: AppTheme.elementSpacing * 1.5),

        // Wrap for the chips
        Wrap(
          spacing: AppTheme.elementSpacing, // Horizontal space between chips
          runSpacing: AppTheme.elementSpacing, // Vertical space between lines
          children: allTags.map((tag) {
            final bool isSelected = selectedTags.contains(tag);
            return TagChip(
              label: tag.tagName,
              selected: isSelected,
              onTap: () => onTagSelected(tag),
            );
          }).toList(),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}

import 'package:dio/dio.dart';
import 'package:injectable/injectable.dart';
import 'package:sahbifit/core/api/api_client.dart';
import 'package:sahbifit/core/constants/api_endpoints.dart';
import 'package:sahbifit/core/errors/exceptions.dart';
import 'package:sahbifit/features/user/data/models/update_fcm_token_model.dart';
import 'package:sahbifit/features/user/data/models/update_visibility_model.dart';
import 'package:sahbifit/features/user/data/models/user_model.dart';

abstract class UserRemoteDatasource {
  Future<UserModel> getMyProfile();
  Future<UserModel> getUserProfile(String userId);
  Future<void> blockUser(String userId);
  Future<void> updateFcmToken(UpdateFcmTokenModel request);
  Future<void> updateProfileVisibility(UpdateVisibilityModel request);
  
  // --- ADDED ---
  Future<List<UserModel>> getMyBlockedUsers();
  Future<void> unblockUser(String userId);
  // --- END ADDED ---
}

@Injectable(as: UserRemoteDatasource)
class UserRemoteDatasourceImpl implements UserRemoteDatasource {
  final ApiClient _apiClient;

  UserRemoteDatasourceImpl(this._apiClient);

  @override
  Future<UserModel> getMyProfile() async {
    try {
      final response = await _apiClient.dio.get(ApiEndpoints.myProfile);
      return UserModel.fromJson(response.data);
    } on DioException catch (e) {
      throw ServerException.fromDio(e);
    }
  }

  @override
  Future<UserModel> getUserProfile(String userId) async {
    try {
      final response = await _apiClient.dio.get(
        ApiEndpoints.getUserProfile(userId),
      );
      return UserModel.fromJson(response.data);
    } on DioException catch (e) {
      throw ServerException.fromDio(e);
    }
  }

  @override
  Future<void> blockUser(String userId) async {
    try {
      await _apiClient.dio.post(
        ApiEndpoints.blockUser(userId),
      );
    } on DioException catch (e) {
      throw ServerException.fromDio(e);
    }
  }

  @override
  Future<void> updateFcmToken(UpdateFcmTokenModel request) async {
    try {
      await _apiClient.dio.put(
        ApiEndpoints.updateFcmToken,
        data: request.toJson(),
      );
    } on DioException catch (e) {
      throw ServerException.fromDio(e);
    }
  }

  @override
  Future<void> updateProfileVisibility(UpdateVisibilityModel request) async {
    try {
      await _apiClient.dio.put(
        ApiEndpoints.updateVisibility,
        data: request.toJson(),
      );
    } on DioException catch (e) {
      throw ServerException.fromDio(e);
    }
  }

  // --- ADDED ---
  @override
  Future<List<UserModel>> getMyBlockedUsers() async {
    try {
      final response = await _apiClient.dio.get(ApiEndpoints.myBlockedUsers);
      // Assuming response.data is a List<dynamic>
      final List<dynamic> data = response.data;
      return data.map((json) => UserModel.fromJson(json)).toList();
    } on DioException catch (e) {
      throw ServerException.fromDio(e);
    }
  }

  @override
  Future<void> unblockUser(String userId) async {
    try {
      // Unblocking is typically a DELETE request
      await _apiClient.dio.delete(
        ApiEndpoints.unblockUser(userId),
      );
    } on DioException catch (e) {
      throw ServerException.fromDio(e);
    }
  }
  // --- END ADDED ---
}

import 'package:freezed_annotation/freezed_annotation.dart';
import 'package:sahbifit/features/user/domain/entities/badge.dart';

part 'badge_model.freezed.dart';
part 'badge_model.g.dart';


@freezed
abstract class BadgeModel with _$BadgeModel {
  const BadgeModel._();

  
  const factory BadgeModel({
    required int badgeId,
    required String badgeName,
    required String description,
    String? iconUrl,
  }) = _BadgeModel;

  factory BadgeModel.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) =>
      _$BadgeModelFromJson(json);

  Badge toEntity() {
    return Badge(
      badgeId: badgeId,
      badgeName: badgeName,
      description: description,
      iconUrl: iconUrl,
    );
  }
}

@freezed
abstract class UserModel with _$UserModel {
  const UserModel._();

  const factory UserModel({
    required String userId,
    required String firstName,
    String? profilePhotoUrl,
    required VerificationStatus verificationStatus,
    required VerifiedGender verifiedGender,
    required ProfileVisibility profileVisibility,
    required UserRole role,
    required UserStatus status,
    required int groupSessionCount,
    required int noShowCount,
    // Default to 0 if backend sends null for older users
    @Default(0) int lateCancelCount, // <--- ADDED
    GymModel? primaryGym,
    @Default([]) List<BadgeModel> userBadges,
  }) = _UserModel;

  factory UserModel.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) =>
      _$UserModelFromJson(json);

  User toEntity() {
    return User(
      userId: userId,
      firstName: firstName,
      profilePhotoUrl: profilePhotoUrl,
      verificationStatus: verificationStatus,
      verifiedGender: verifiedGender,
      profileVisibility: profileVisibility,
      role: role,
      status: status,
      groupSessionCount: groupSessionCount,
      noShowCount: noShowCount,
      lateCancelCount: lateCancelCount, // <--- ADDED
      primaryGym: primaryGym?.toEntity(),
      userBadges: userBadges.map((badge) => badge.toEntity()).toList(),
    );
  }
}

@freezed
abstract class UserSummaryModel with _$UserSummaryModel {
  const UserSummaryModel._();

  const factory UserSummaryModel({
    required String userId,
    required String firstName,
    String? profilePhotoUrl,
  }) = _UserSummaryModel;

  factory UserSummaryModel.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) =>
      _$UserSummaryModelFromJson(json);

  /// Converts this summary into a full User entity.
  /// We fill missing fields with safe defaults since they aren't needed for the Feed.
  User toEntity() {
    return User(
      userId: userId,
      firstName: firstName,
      profilePhotoUrl: profilePhotoUrl,
      // --- Defaults for fields not present in Summary DTO ---
      verificationStatus: VerificationStatus.verified, // Assume verified for display purposes
      verifiedGender: VerifiedGender.notVerified,
      profileVisibility: ProfileVisibility.all,
      role: UserRole.member,
      status: UserStatus.active,
      groupSessionCount: 0,
      lateCancelCount:0,
      noShowCount: 0,
      userBadges: const [],
    );
  }
}

    }

      throw ServerFailure(message: e.message);
    }
  }

      throw ServerFailure(message: e.message);
    }
  }

import 'package:bloc/bloc.dart';
import 'package:freezed_annotation/freezed_annotation.dart';
import 'package:injectable/injectable.dart';
import 'package:sahbifit/core/errors/failure.dart';
import 'package:sahbifit/core/usecases/usecase.dart';
import 'package:sahbifit/features/user/domain/entities/user.dart';
import 'package:sahbifit/features/user/domain/enums/profile_visibility.dart';
import 'package:sahbifit/features/user/domain/usecases/get_my_profile.dart';
import 'package:sahbifit/features/user/domain/usecases/update_profile_visibility.dart';

part 'profile_bloc.freezed.dart';
part 'profile_event.dart';
part 'profile_state.dart';

@injectable
class ProfileBloc extends Bloc<ProfileEvent, ProfileState> {
  final GetMyProfile _getMyProfile;
  final UpdateProfileVisibility _updateProfileVisibility;

  ProfileBloc(
    this._getMyProfile,
    this._updateProfileVisibility,
  ) : super(const ProfileState.initial()) {
    on<_LoadMyProfile>(_onLoadMyProfile);
    on<_VisibilityChanged>(_onVisibilityChanged);
  }

  /// Handles fetching the current user's profile.
  Future<void> _onLoadMyProfile(
    _LoadMyProfile event,
    Emitter<ProfileState> emit,
  ) async {
    emit(const ProfileState.loading());
    try {
      final user = await _getMyProfile(NoParams());
      emit(ProfileState.loaded(user: user));
    } on ServerFailure catch (e) {
      emit(ProfileState.error(e.message));
    } catch (e) {
      emit(ProfileState.error(e.toString()));
    }
  }

  /// Handles updating the user's profile visibility.
  Future<void> _onVisibilityChanged(
    _VisibilityChanged event,
    Emitter<ProfileState> emit,
  ) async {
    // You might want to show a more subtle loading,
    // e.g., by adding a bool to the 'Loaded' state:
    // emit(ProfileState.loaded(user: currentUser, isUpdating: true));
    emit(const ProfileState.loading());

    try {
      final params = UpdateProfileVisibilityParams(
        visibility: event.newVisibility,
      );
      await _updateProfileVisibility(params);

      // On success, dispatch an event to reload the profile
      // to get the updated user object.
      add(const ProfileEvent.loadMyProfile());
    } on ServerFailure catch (e) {
      emit(ProfileState.error(e.message));
    } catch (e) {
      emit(ProfileState.error(e.toString()));
    }
  }
}

part of 'profile_bloc.dart';

@freezed
sealed class ProfileState with _$ProfileState {
  /// The initial state, before the profile has been loaded.
  const factory ProfileState.initial() = _Initial;

  /// The state while the profile is being fetched or updated.
  const factory ProfileState.loading() = _Loading;

  /// The state when the user's profile has been successfully loaded.
  const factory ProfileState.loaded({required User user}) = _Loaded;

  /// The state when an error occurred while fetching or updating.
  const factory ProfileState.error(String message) = _Error;
}

import 'package:bloc/bloc.dart';
import 'package:freezed_annotation/freezed_annotation.dart';
import 'package:injectable/injectable.dart';
import 'package:sahbifit/core/errors/failure.dart';
import 'package:sahbifit/core/usecases/usecase.dart';
import 'package:sahbifit/features/user/domain/entities/user.dart';
import 'package:sahbifit/features/user/domain/usecases/get_my_blocked_users.dart';
import 'package:sahbifit/features/user/domain/usecases/unblock_user.dart';

part 'blocked_users_cubit.freezed.dart';
part 'blocked_users_state.dart';

@injectable
class BlockedUsersCubit extends Cubit<BlockedUsersState> {
  final GetMyBlockedUsers _getMyBlockedUsers;
  final UnblockUser _unblockUser;

  BlockedUsersCubit(this._getMyBlockedUsers, this._unblockUser)
      : super(const BlockedUsersState.initial());

  Future<void> loadBlockedUsers() async {
    emit(const BlockedUsersState.loading());
    try {
      final users = await _getMyBlockedUsers(NoParams());
      emit(BlockedUsersState.loaded(users: users));
    } on ServerFailure catch (e) {
      emit(BlockedUsersState.error(message: e.message));
    }
  }

  Future<void> unblockUser(String userId) async {
    // Optimistic: Don't show a loading spinner, just refresh the list.
    try {
      await _unblockUser(UnblockUserParams(userId: userId));
      // Refresh the list
      await loadBlockedUsers();
    } on ServerFailure catch (e) {
      // On error, emit the error but keep the old list
      state.maybeMap(
        loaded: (s) => emit(s.copyWith(errorMessage: e.message)),
        orElse: () => emit(BlockedUsersState.error(message: e.message)),
      );
    }
  }
}

// lib/features/user/presentation/cubit/user_profile_cubit.dart
import 'package:bloc/bloc.dart';
import 'package:freezed_annotation/freezed_annotation.dart';
import 'package:injectable/injectable.dart';
import 'package:sahbifit/core/errors/failure.dart';
import 'package:sahbifit/features/user/domain/entities/user.dart';
import 'package:sahbifit/features/user/domain/usecases/get_user_profile.dart';

part 'user_profile_cubit.freezed.dart';
part 'user_profile_state.dart';

@injectable
class UserProfileCubit extends Cubit<UserProfileState> {
  final GetUserProfile _getUserProfile;

  UserProfileCubit(this._getUserProfile)
      : super(const UserProfileState.initial());

  /// Fetches a specific user's profile by their ID.
  Future<void> loadUserProfile(String userId) async {
    emit(const UserProfileState.loading());
    try {
      // Call the use case with the required parameters
      final user = await _getUserProfile(GetUserProfileParams(userId: userId));
      emit(UserProfileState.loaded(user));
    } on ServerFailure catch (e) {
      emit(UserProfileState.error(e.message));
    } catch (e) {
      emit(UserProfileState.error(e.toString()));
    }
  }
}

part of 'user_profile_cubit.dart';

@freezed
sealed class UserProfileState with _$UserProfileState {
  /// The initial state, before the profile has been loaded.
  const factory UserProfileState.initial() = _Initial;

  /// The state while the profile is being fetched.
  const factory UserProfileState.loading() = _Loading;

  /// The state when the user's profile has been successfully loaded.
  const factory UserProfileState.loaded(User user) = _Loaded;

  /// The state when an error occurred while fetching.
  const factory UserProfileState.error(String message) = _Error;
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';
import 'package:sahbifit/core/config/app_theme.dart';
import 'package:sahbifit/core/di/service_locator.dart';
import 'package:sahbifit/features/user/domain/entities/user.dart'; // Ensure correct import
import 'package:sahbifit/features/user/presentation/cubit/blocked_users_cubit.dart';
import 'package:sahbifit/shared/widgets/app_bars/custom_app_bar.dart';
import 'package:sahbifit/shared/widgets/dialogs/custom_dialogs.dart'; // Import ConfirmationDialog
import 'package:sahbifit/shared/widgets/states/loading_states.dart';

class BlockedUsersPage extends StatelessWidget {
  const BlockedUsersPage({super.key});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return BlocProvider(
      create: (context) => getIt<BlockedUsersCubit>()..loadBlockedUsers(),
      child: Scaffold(
        appBar: const CustomAppBar(title: 'Blocked Users'),
        body: BlocConsumer<BlockedUsersCubit, BlockedUsersState>(
          listener: (context, state) {
            state.maybeMap(
              loaded: (s) {
                if (s.errorMessage != null) {
                  ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
                    SnackBar(
                      content: Text(s.errorMessage!),
                      backgroundColor: AppTheme.primaryRed,
                    ),
                  );
                }
              },
              orElse: () {},
            );
          },
          builder: (context, state) {
            return state.when(
              initial: () => const LoadingIndicator(),
              loading: () => const LoadingIndicator(),
              error: (message) => ErrorStateWidget(
                message: message,
                buttonText: 'Retry',
                onRetry: () =>
                    context.read<BlockedUsersCubit>().loadBlockedUsers(),
              ),
              loaded: (users, errorMessage) { // Fix destructuring
                if (users.isEmpty) {
                  return const Center(
                    child: EmptyStateWidget(
                      icon: Icons.person_off_outlined,
                      title: 'No Blocked Users',
                      message: 'You haven\'t blocked anyone yet.',
                    ),
                  );
                }
                return ListView.separated(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(AppTheme.defaultPadding),
                  itemCount: users.length,
                  separatorBuilder: (context, index) => const Divider(height: 1),
                  itemBuilder: (context, index) {
                    final user = users[index];
                    return _BlockedUserTile(user: user);
                  },
                );
              },
            );
          },
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _BlockedUserTile extends StatelessWidget {
  final User user;

  const _BlockedUserTile({required this.user});

  void _confirmUnblock(BuildContext context) {
    showDialog(
      context: context,
      builder: (dialogContext) => ConfirmationDialog(
        title: 'Unblock ${user.firstName}?',
        message: 'They will be able to see your profile and sessions again. Are you sure?',
        confirmText: 'Unblock',
        cancelText: 'Cancel',
        onConfirm: () {
          // Call the Cubit from the parent context
          context.read<BlockedUsersCubit>().unblockUser(user.userId);
        },
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return ListTile(
      contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
      leading: CircleAvatar(
        backgroundImage: user.profilePhotoUrl != null
            ? NetworkImage(user.profilePhotoUrl!)
            : null,
        backgroundColor: AppTheme.lightGray,
        child: user.profilePhotoUrl == null
            ? const Icon(Icons.person, color: AppTheme.disabledGray)
            : null,
      ),
      title: Text(
        user.firstName,
        style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleMedium,
      ),
      trailing: TextButton(
        onPressed: () => _confirmUnblock(context),
        style: TextButton.styleFrom(
          foregroundColor: AppTheme.darkGray, // Neutral color for unblock
        ),
        child: const Text('Unblock'),
      ),
    );
  }
}

// --- TAB 1: ATTENDANCE ---
class _AttendanceList extends StatelessWidget {
  const _AttendanceList();

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return BlocBuilder<ProfileBloc, ProfileState>(
      builder: (context, profileState) {
        return profileState.maybeWhen(
          loaded: (myself) {
            return BlocBuilder<MySessionsCubit, MySessionsState>(
              builder: (context, sessionState) {
                if (sessionState is MySessionsLoaded) {
                  // Filter: 
                  // 1. I am the creator
                  // 2. Session has started (startTime < now)
                  final now = DateTime.now();
                  final sessionsToManage = [
                    ...sessionState.upcomingSessions, 
                    ...sessionState.pastSessions
                  ].where((s) => s.creator.userId == myself.userId && s.startTime.isBefore(now)).toList();

                  if (sessionsToManage.isEmpty) {
                    return const EmptyStateWidget(
                      icon: Icons.playlist_add_check,
                      title: 'Nothing to Mark',
                      message: 'Sessions you host will appear here after they start.',
                    );
                  }

                  return ListView.separated(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
                    itemCount: sessionsToManage.length,
                    separatorBuilder: (ctx, i) => const SizedBox(height: 12),
                    itemBuilder: (context, index) {
                      final session = sessionsToManage[index];
                      return _AttendanceCard(session: session);
                    },
                  );
                }
                return const LoadingIndicator();
              },
            );
          },
          orElse: () => const LoadingIndicator(),
        );
      },
    );
  }
}

class _AttendanceCard extends StatelessWidget {
  final Session session;
  const _AttendanceCard({required this.session});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Card(
      elevation: 2,
      child: ListTile(
        title: Text(session.title, style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold)),
        subtitle: Text('${session.participantCount} Participants â€¢ ${session.gym.name}'),
        trailing: ElevatedButton(
          style: AppTheme.primaryButtonStyle.copyWith(
            padding: const WidgetStatePropertyAll(EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 8)),
          ),
          onPressed: () {
            context.push('/session/${session.sessionId}/attendance');
          },
          child: const Text("Mark"),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

// --- TAB 2: RATINGS ---
class _PendingRatingsList extends StatelessWidget {
  const _PendingRatingsList();

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return BlocBuilder<PendingRatingBloc, PendingRatingState>(
      builder: (context, state) {
        return state.maybeWhen(
          loading: () => const LoadingIndicator(),
          loaded: (ratings) {
            if (ratings.isEmpty) {
              return const EmptyStateWidget(
                icon: Icons.star_outline,
                title: 'All Caught Up',
                message: 'You have no pending ratings.',
              );
            }
            return ListView.separated(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
              itemCount: ratings.length,
              separatorBuilder: (ctx, i) => const Divider(),
              itemBuilder: (context, index) {
                final rating = ratings[index];
                return ListTile(
                  leading: const CircleAvatar(child: Icon(Icons.person)),
                  title: Text("Rate ${rating.userNameToRate}"),
                  subtitle: Text("Session: ${rating.sessionTitle}"),
                  trailing: const Icon(Icons.chevron_right),
                  onTap: () {
                    showModalBottomSheet(
                      context: context,
                      isScrollControlled: true,
                      backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
                      builder: (dialogContext) {
                        return BlocProvider.value(
                          value: context.read<PendingRatingBloc>(),
                          child: CreateRatingDialog(
                            pendingRating: rating,
                            onSubmit: (val, comment) {
                              context.read<PendingRatingBloc>().add(
                                PendingRatingEvent.submitRating(
                                  sessionId: rating.sessionId,
                                  ratedUserId: rating.userIdToRate,
                                  ratingValue: val,
                                  comment: comment,
                                )
                              );
                              Navigator.pop(dialogContext);
                            },
                          ),
                        );
                      },
                    );
                  },
                );
              },
            );
          },
          orElse: () => const LoadingIndicator(),
        );
      },
    );
  }
}
